coordinates.object_orientation: Head toward -Y, tail +Y, limbs across X, feet on Z=0. +X side is primary crest-profile view.

concept.reason: Taxon-specific anatomical papers and real mounted skull photo support diagnostic crown. Do not spend time generating decorative concepts.

scope: Whole organism; do not replace with skull-only or generic renamed dinosaur.
specimen_basis: IVPP 84019: skull, pelvis and vertebral column through sixth caudal. Limbs and distal tail not preserved in this specimen.

scale.basis: NHM indexed museum profile approximate whole-body estimate; not directly measured complete specimen.

diagnostic_targets: Single long median head crest, laterally thin, extending from above nasal region toward between eyes. Side upper edge approximately straight and near-parallel to upper-jaw tooth margin, not a pointed horn.
Long relatively low snout under crest, articulated jaw and modest bony brow relief. No twin Dilophosaurus crests, no nasal Ceratosaurus horn.
Continuous theropod trunk, neck, muscular hind legs and long balancing tail; no dorsal sail or Concavenator hump.
Original stylized geometry with clear limb negative space and rounded-faceted volumes, not separate disconnected primitives.
uncertainties: Limbs and distal tail are comparative basal-tetanuran reconstruction; do not label them as observed holotype anatomy.
Skin, colour, soft-tissue crest cover and pose unknown. Use muted neutral palette and no speculative spikes or elaborate feather fans.
Mounted skull can include restoration; use primary published diagnosis to constrain crest, not commercial casts.
acceptance_checks: Top and front show exactly one central crest; side shows elongated low head and long nearly level crest top.
Three main weight-bearing toes per hindfoot and three separate forelimb digits are comparative reconstruction; palms inward.
Tail airborne, feet stable, continuous joints; no floating eyes, claws or teeth.
Four fixed views, perspective can reuse preview; no extra views absent specific defect.
No image textures, downloaded mesh or external temporary dependencies.
handoff_contract: Same directory across maker and independent QA. Maker reports COMPLETE with actual paths/hash to root and stops; no upload or cleanup. Root backs up asynchronously; retain local until integration, published and recoverable.
